Supports AR CLDN16/CLDN19 FHHNC phenotype and nephrocalcinosis.

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: CLDN19 disease or distal-tubule TRPM6 dysfunction.
second_answer_attack.resolution: CLDN19 can produce a closely related renal phenotype, but the stem explicitly identifies a homozygous CLDN16 variant and normal ophthalmologic examination. The lead asks the transport process caused by this variant: paracellular Mg/Ca reabsorption in the TAL. TRPM6 is transcellular DCT Mg uptake; Gitelman causes hypocalciuria rather than marked hypercalciuria.
